blueprint.name: BNK 2.4.2 Host on an existing cluster
blueprint.description: Installs F5 BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes 2.4.2 in Host mode on a cluster you already run, with the installer from the bnk-host-deploy repository.

outcomes: Multus and cert-manager, with the CA issuer BNK signs from
CNEInstance on release manifest 2.4.2, TMM on the node you name
Licence Active, verification passed, the cluster registered in Forge

prerequisites.name: kubeconfig
prerequisites.description: A kubeconfig for the target cluster, reachable from Forge's runner containers.

prerequisites.name: far_service_account_key
prerequisites.description: The F5 Artifact Registry service-account key (cne_pull_64.json).

prerequisites.name: bnk_license_jwt
prerequisites.description: The BNK licence token from MyF5.

required.name: tmm_node
required.description: The node TMM runs on (kubectl get nodes).
